title: When the Archive Breaks Revisited
author: C. M. Lockridge
blurb: Noor Okafor, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
